name: Columbia Gulf Pulaski Project

values.EndLocation: South Somerset Delivery Meter Station, Pulaski County

researcher_notes: Existing P6533 is the Columbia Gulf system with no length or owner. No row exists for the Pulaski project, so it is a new expansion row under the parent name. A Federal Register notice from November 2025 for docket CP26-11-000 says Columbia Gulf Transmission proposes 41.3 miles of new 30-inch pipe from Lincoln County to a new South Somerset meter station in Pulaski County, Kentucky, to deliver 260,000 dekatherms per day to East Kentucky Power Cooperative's Cooper power station. The application was filed 15 October 2025. FERC held scoping meetings in December 2025. The EIA August 2026 project list (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 100, 'Pulaski Expansion Project') gives status Applied, 41 miles, 260 MMcf/d, 30 inches, cost 400 million dollars, in service 2029. EIA and the Federal Register notice are not fully independent of the FERC filing. Capacity is the incremental figure. Route: no official geographic data found yet. Route type unavailable pending the FERC environmental filings. Owner style adopted: Columbia Gulf Transmission LLC. Parent TC Energy matches the gazetteer. The TC Energy project page loads but its body text could not be read from static HTML, so it is not cited.
